title.en: Keep LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm as printed while Electric vehicle only supplies the map
title.zh: LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm照印，Electric vehicle只当路线图

description.en: The LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm note follows the outline of Electric vehicle. LZ-60 is a diesel trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. That slash is the pipe cell. The separate conveying-distance cell is 100 m. Wall thickness is not printed.
description.zh: LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm这篇笔记顺着《Electric vehicle》的大纲写。LZ-60 是邢台制造的柴油拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。斜线那一格才是管径。另一格输送距离是 100 m。壁厚没有印出。

h1.en: LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm: sections borrowed from Electric vehicle
h1.zh: LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm：章节借自《Electric vehicle》

directAnswer.en: For LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Electric vehicle. Electric vehicle only lends its headings. LZ-60 is a diesel trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. That slash is the pipe cell. The separate conveying-distance cell is 100 m. Wall thickness is not printed.
directAnswer.zh: 写LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Electric vehicle》借数字。《Electric vehicle》只出借标题。 LZ-60 是邢台制造的柴油拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。斜线那一格才是管径。另一格输送距离是 100 m。壁厚没有印出。

body.en: Where the source outline says “History”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The sheet prints engine 6105 / 145 kW, output 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, size 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m, weight 5500 kg. Order the spare from the Concrete Pump Delivery Pipe page. That page is a red straight pipe with reinforced coupling ends. It has no fixed diameter table and no wall thickness. Diesel 60 prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132, engine 6105 / 144 kW, output 35 m³/h and pressure 30 MPa, with no delivery-pipe diameter. Do not move the LZ-60 pipe cell onto Diesel 60. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“历史”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 参数表印出发动机 6105 / 145 kW、输送量 50 m³/h、泵送压力 35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、输送管 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、重量 5500 kg。 直管从混凝土泵输送管页询价。那一页是带加强快接端的红色直管，没有固定管径表，也没有壁厚。柴油60印的是 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132、发动机 6105 / 144 kW、输送量 35 m³/h、压力 30 MPa，没有输送管内径。不要把 LZ-60 的管径格挪到柴油60上。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: “Electricity sources” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Send this model name, the inner diameter printed on its own page, the length you need, and the quantity. Do not send a wall thickness. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Electricity sources”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写上这一型号、它自己页面上的内径、需要的长度和数量。不要填写壁厚。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The heading “Components” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. LZ-60 is a diesel trailer pump made in Xingtai. Its delivery-pipe cell is 100 / 125 mm. That slash is the pipe cell. The separate conveying-distance cell is 100 m. Wall thickness is not printed. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 标题“部件”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 LZ-60 是邢台制造的柴油拖泵。输送管一格是 100 / 125 mm。斜线那一格才是管径。另一格输送距离是 100 m。壁厚没有印出。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Types”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“类型”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Charging/fueling”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Charging/fueling”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Considerations”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_vehicle
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Considerations”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electric_vehicle

question.en: Can the outline heading “Considerations” rename LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm?
question.zh: 大纲标题“来源章节：Considerations”可以改掉LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的名称吗？

answer.en: No. The spare page has no fixed size table. The figure comes from this model's specification cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。直管页没有固定尺寸表。数字来自这一型号参数表上的格子。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Does “History” on Electric vehicle fill a blank on the LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm row?
question.zh: 《Electric vehicle》上的“历史”会填上LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm的空白格子吗？

answer.en: No. A metre figure for horizontal or vertical conveying is distance, not a cut length for the spare. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。水平或垂直的米数是输送距离，不是配件的截取长度。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

question.en: Why is Electric vehicle not a source of extra ratings for LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm?
question.zh: 为什么《Electric vehicle》不能给LZ-60 delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm增加额定值？

answer.en: Neither is printed. Both are missing fields. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 都没有印。两项都是缺字段。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
